title: How does the artifact-level direction heuristic relate to claim-level Governance Planes?
question: How does the artifact-level direction heuristic relate to claim-level Governance Planes?
answer: LD-19: The artifact-level direction model is shorthand that collapses an artifact into its dominant claim. Governance Planes still classify claims only; ADR-000A is unchanged and the whole-artifact metaphor is withdrawn. "Grounding is transient" holds for Grounding claims.
